description: Generates streams of random vectors that point in every direction of an N-dimensional space with equal probability, for driving physics simulations such as Nucleus

outputs.text: An independent stream of random vectors; every channel is drawn from a normal distribution with a mean of 0V and a standard deviation of 3V, and the channel count is the same on all ten ports

menu: Output channels — sets how many dimensions each vector has, 1 to 16, with a default of 3 to suit the 3D Sapphire modules; the count appears on the panel display
